segments.contextAfter: They allow you to configure how pressure from a pressure-sensitive device, such as the Force Touch trackpad, is interpreted by the system.

segments.contextAfter: For example, a drawing or painting app may adjust the behavior of pressure events to focus on variable pressure and prevent force clicks from occurring.
